entry_points.name: close_account
entry_points.note: Sets deleted_at on the user row and commits; it calls nothing else.

entry_points.name: purge_closed_accounts
entry_points.note: Celery task that hard-deletes user rows closed longer ago than the cutoff.

stores.name: users

fields.name: deleted_at
fields.note: Soft-delete marker written by close_account and read by the purge task.

erasure.note: close_account only writes deleted_at; the row is removed by the scheduled purge task once deleted_at is older than RETENTION_DAYS.

stores.note: Single table holding the account holder record.

stores.name: uploads/avatars

fields.name: avatar_key
fields.note: The S3 object key is built from the user id.

fields.name: original_filename
fields.note: The uploader's own filename is stored as S3 object metadata.

erasure.note: cleanup_user_files is defined but no other module calls it, and neither close_account nor the purge task touches storage, so the avatar object stays after the row is deleted; the close_account docstring says uploaded files are removed.

stores.note: S3 bucket holding one avatar object per user id.

stores.name: stripe.Customer

fields.name: name
fields.note: The user's full_name is sent as the Stripe customer name.

erasure.note: The repository creates the Stripe customer and contains no call that deletes or redacts it.

stores.note: Stripe customer records created from the signup route.

stores.name: nightly_backup

fields.name: email
fields.note: DUMP_COLUMNS names the user columns copied into the dump file.

fields.name: full_name
fields.note: DUMP_COLUMNS names the user columns copied into the dump file.

erasure.note: The dump file is rewritten on the cron schedule in SCHEDULE and BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS states 35 days, but no code in the repository reads that constant or removes an old dump.

stores.note: JSON file written by the nightly dump job from the users table.

retention.criteria: rows whose deleted_at is older than the cutoff are deleted

bad_citations.expected: cite the line where avatar_key appears, or drop the claim
